Backup page par \"Backup download\" daba: Backup page par "Backup download" dabayein. Saara data ek file me aa jata hai. Is file ko Google Drive ya email me safe rakhein. Ye sirf malik kar sakta hai.
Billing → Plans me plan aur muddat chune: Billing → Plans me plan aur period chunein. Bill banega; bank ya wallet se payment karke screenshot upload karein. Manzoor hote hi plan chalu. Istemaal tab me had dekh sakte hain.
Login page par \"Password bhool gaye\" d: Login page par "Password bhool gaye" dabayein aur email par aaya link kholein. Login ho to Profile → Security se password badal sakte hain.
Products page par \"Naya product\" dabay: Products page par "Naya product" dabayein. Naam, price, cost aur stock likhein, barcode ho to scan karein, phir save. Tasveer aur variants baad me bhi daal sakte hain.
Purchase (purchase) darj karne se stock: Purchase darj karne se stock barhta hai, sale se ghat-ta hai. Kami-beshi, kharab ya gum maal ke liye Stock adjustments use karein. Har tabdeeli Stock ka aana jana me likhi jati hai.
